description: HTML source code for a web-based database visualizer interface, including styles, structure, and client-side script for fetching and displaying database and table data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases and populates the sidebar

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resetting current selections

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands/collapses database entries and loads their tables

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for a selected table

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Builds HTML table from data array

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Prepares individual cell's HTML based on its value

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Toggles expansion of cell content for long/complex data
